headline: Public hearings on wetlands notices for Independence Drive, Cross Street, and new requests at Briarcliff Drive and Lyndale Ave.
summary: The commission will continue hearings on notices of intent at 1-27 Independence Drive and 11 Cross Street, and take up new Requests for Determination of Applicability at 7 Briarcliff Drive and 40 Lyndale Ave. Old business includes a stormwater permit for 11 Cross Street, several notices of violation, and two emergency certifications.
